name: angel
_about: A winged person (winged.js): the whole person -- makePerson's options under `person` -- with a bird's wings from the back of the chest (mammals.js birdWing: primaries rooted on the hand, secondaries along the forearm, coverts over their roots). k: the span, x the rig's 1 m wing; lift: how far the arms rise (degrees).
